boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Harvard University
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe food destinations in Harvard Square and nearby Central Square with late service.

cards.title: El Jefe's Taqueria
cards.subtitle: 14 Brattle St, Harvard Square
cards.notes: Use the Harvard Square counter when a late meal is needed; confirm holiday changes before leaving, since the posted schedule is daily.
cards.short_summary: A Harvard Square taqueria with the latest documented hours on this board.
cards.evidence_claim: El Jefe's lists its Harvard Square location at 14 Brattle Street as open 8 a.m.–4 a.m., seven days a week.
cards.source_title: El Jefe's Taqueria — Harvard Square hours and location
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Harvard Square hours as 8 a.m.–4 a.m., seven days a week.

cards.title: Madras Dosa Co.
cards.subtitle: 22 Eliot St, Harvard Square
cards.notes: Head to Eliot Street for a late dosa or other South Indian fare; the location page lists the same hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A late-open South Indian restaurant a short walk from Harvard Yard.
cards.evidence_claim: Madras Dosa Co. lists its Harvard Square restaurant at 22 Eliot Street as open 11 a.m.–3 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official locations page lists Harvard Square hours as 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: Felipe's Taqueria
cards.subtitle: 21 Brattle St, Harvard Square
cards.notes: Use the taqueria’s food service on Brattle Street for a late meal; check the day because its closing time changes later in the week.
cards.short_summary: A Harvard Square taqueria with documented nightly hours past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Felipe's official contact page lists 7 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 7 a.m.–2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 7 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 7 a.m.–2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Pinocchio's Pizza & Subs
cards.subtitle: 74 Winthrop St, Harvard Square
cards.notes: Walk to Winthrop Street for pizza or subs after an evening on campus; Friday and Saturday hours extend during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A pizza-and-subs counter with posted academic-year late-weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pinocchio's lists Monday–Saturday hours until 1 a.m., extending to 2 a.m. Fridays and Saturdays when students are in session September–May.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Monday–Saturday until 1 a.m.; Friday and Saturday extend to 2 a.m. September–May while students are in session.

cards.title: Tasty Burger — Harvard Square
cards.subtitle: 40 JFK St, Harvard Square
cards.notes: Use the JFK Street location for a late burger or shake on Friday or Saturday; weekday closing is earlier on the posted schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Harvard Square burger counter with 2 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Tasty Burger lists its Harvard Square restaurant at 40 JFK Street open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Tasty Burger — Harvard Square hours and location
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Shake Shack — Harvard Square
cards.subtitle: 92 Winthrop St, Harvard Square
cards.notes: Choose the Winthrop Street Shack for a Friday or Saturday food stop; it lists dine-in, walkup, and delivery among its order types.
cards.short_summary: A burger-and-shake stop with midnight hours at the end of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack lists its Harvard Square location at 92 Winthrop Street open until midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–midnight; it also lists dine-in, walkup, and delivery.

cards.title: J.P. Licks — Harvard Square
cards.subtitle: 1312 Massachusetts Ave, Harvard Square
cards.notes: Stop on Massachusetts Avenue for ice cream, frozen yogurt, or coffee; Friday and Saturday service runs to midnight on the posted schedule.
cards.short_summary: An ice-cream, yogurt, and coffee shop with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: J.P. Licks lists its Harvard Square shop at 1312 Massachusetts Avenue open until 11 p.m. most nights and midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: J.P. Licks — Harvard Square location and hours
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–11 p.m., Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–midnight, and Sunday 10 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: The Maharaja
cards.subtitle: 57 JFK St, Harvard Square
cards.notes: Plan a seated dinner at this JFK Street restaurant on Friday or Saturday, when its posted schedule extends an hour beyond weeknight closing.
cards.short_summary: An Indian restaurant in Harvard Square with documented 11 p.m. weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Maharaja lists Friday and Saturday hours until 11 p.m. at 57 JFK Street in Harvard Square.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday 12 p.m.–11 p.m. and Saturday 12 p.m.–11 p.m.; other listed days close at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Clover — Central Square
cards.subtitle: 496 Massachusetts Ave, Central Square
cards.notes: Make Central Square the longer late option when Harvard Square is winding down; the official schedule posts midnight service Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Central Square vegetarian restaurant with midnight hours on four nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Clover lists its Central Square location at 496 Massachusetts Avenue open until midnight Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official schedule lists Central Square open 10 a.m.–midnight Wednesday–Saturday, and until 11 p.m. Sunday–Tuesday.

cards.title: The Mad Monkfish
cards.subtitle: 524 Massachusetts Ave, Central Square
cards.notes: Use this Central Square restaurant for a later Sunday sushi or dinner option; its official ordering page posts a 12:15 a.m. Sunday close.
cards.short_summary: A Central Square sushi and Asian restaurant with a documented after-midnight Sunday close.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mad Monkfish's official ordering page lists Sunday hours from 11:15 a.m. to 12:15 a.m. at 524 Massachusetts Avenue.
cards.source_title: The Mad Monkfish official ordering page
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant ordering page lists Sunday hours of 11:15 a.m.–12:15 a.m.; confirm other days separately.
